name: Book Return

angles.text: As a mage, you know careless handling of arcane books like “Fun with Elementals” can put dangerous knowledge within reach of kobolds.
As an Alliance member, you see Northshire Abbey and Goldshire’s garrison working together to protect books and dangerous magical texts from Elwynn’s pests.

faq.answer: Marshal Dughan in Goldshire sends you into Fargodeep Mine for books belonging to Brother Paxton. One is “Fun with Elementals,” a magical primer Paxton is especially anxious to recover.
faq.q: What is the quest Book Return?

aliases: how did books get into fargodeep
why are books in fargodeep mine
faq.answer: Kobolds who stole Brother Paxton’s books from Northshire were tracked to Fargodeep Mine. Kobolds now overrun its tunnels, and Paxton wants the books gathered before they are ruined or misused.
faq.q: Why are Brother Paxton's books inside Fargodeep Mine?

faq.answer: “Fun with Elementals” is an introductory book about conjuring that Brother Paxton is desperate to recover. He fears its simple instructions could let even a kobold summon an elemental servant deep in the mine.
faq.q: What is the book 'Fun with Elementals'?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton is a cleric at Northshire Abbey devoted to study, records, and literature. Some books he has lost contain potent, basic magic.

Marshal Dughan oversees Elwynn Forest’s defense from Goldshire. As he sends you to investigate kobolds in Fargodeep Mine, he also seeks to help Brother Paxton recover his books before the kobolds become a greater magical threat.
faq.q: Why is Marshal Dughan involved in retrieving books?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton fears a simple guide could teach the kobolds to conjure elemental forces. Their growing presence in the mine already threatens Elwynn.
faq.q: Could a kobold really summon an elemental?

sections.body: Marshal Dughan sends you into Fargodeep Mine for books belonging to Brother Paxton of Northshire Abbey. Kobolds have overrun the mine, and Paxton fears they might read “Fun with Elementals.” Its simple instructions could teach them to summon an elemental in the tunnels.
sections.title: Lost Pages in the Dark

sections.body: Fargodeep Mine once brought gold to the kingdom of Stormwind. Now kobolds overrun its lower levels, while Elwynn’s defenders are stretched thin. The damp, dangerous caverns threaten the books. You carry the recovered volumes in a protective book bag, keeping Paxton’s records safe and arcane lessons beyond the kobolds’ reach.
sections.title: Knowledge in Peril

summary: In Elwynn, Marshal Dughan sends you to Fargodeep Mine for Brother Paxton’s lost books. One volume, “Fun with Elementals,” could place dangerous instructions in kobold hands.
